d:
The Timberwolves defeated the Raptors, 117-94 tonight in Minnesota. Anthony Edwards finished with a team-high 26 points along with 3 assists and 2 three pointers for the Timberwolves, while LaMelo Ball tallied 15 points, 8 assists and 4 three pointers in the game. Ja'Kobe Walter recorded 22 points, 5 three pointers and 4 rebounds. The Timberwolves improve their record to 3-0 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 2-1 for the season.
